ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximate 65:35 ratio of high-intensity (white) to low-intensity (black) pixels across the visible ventral fluke surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Contiguous white field occupying the majority of the left lobe with dark mottling at the edges; right lobe displays a large white distal blob separated from the central black region by a prominent diagonal dark band.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped central notch with a measured internal angle of approximately 52 degrees.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency serration along the continuous trailing edge; amplitude of peaks increases significantly toward the distal tips, presenting a jagged, irregular boundary.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex curvature along the trailing edge leading to sharp, upward-tapered distal lobe tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Dense clusters of roughly circular, high-contrast calcified structures (barnacles) localized at both distal lobe tips; several small dark circular spots on the white field of the right lobe.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: One prominent, dark linear mark extending approximately 15% of the right lobe width; several smaller, horizontal linear pixel disruptions on the left lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive barnacle colonization at the extreme distal tips and a distinct long linear pigmentation scar on the right lobe.
other_distinctive_markers: The barnacle clusters create a unique, irregular physical protrusion extending beyond the soft-tissue boundary of the fluke tips.
